title: 'All about acceleration': After Nvidia earnings, the tech trade is getting more segmented
title_zh: “一切都在加速”：英伟达盈利后，科技行业变得更加细分
summary: As the AI trade shifts into its next stage, winners and losers are likely to be increasingly segmented, strategists say.
summary_zh: 策略师表示，随着人工智能贸易进入下一阶段，赢家和输家可能会日益分化。

title: Apple's big handoff and a jobs report: What to watch this week
title_zh: 苹果的重大交接和就业报告：本周值得关注的内容
summary: A roiling bond market hits jobs week — but the quarter's earnings season isn't done yet.
summary_zh: 动荡的债券市场迎来了就业周，但本季度的财报季尚未结束。
